hero.lead: Don't want to travel alone, and your friends' dates never line up? Tell us where, when and on what budget — we'll sort out the rest together.

how.title: How it works
how.lead: Just three steps. Nothing to install — it all runs inside Telegram.
how.s1t: Tell us the destination, dates and budget. We'll find people who fit — and tell you why.
how.s2t: Tap "I'm in" on a group you like, or start your own trip and send the link to friends.
how.s3t: Plan, tickets, costs and chat in one place. And a shared album when you're back.

compare.b1: Scattered posts in Telegram groups, strangers you know nothing about
compare.b2: Even with a buddy, the plan lives in WhatsApp and costs in a notebook
compare.b3: Nothing is left once the trip is over
compare.n1: Profiles verified via Telegram and phone, plus reviews
compare.n2: One trip room: chat, plan, checklist, costs, polls
compare.n3: A memories album and a trip story you can share

room.title: Trip room
room.lead: As soon as the group is set, your room opens. No more Telegram chat, Excel sheet and paper list.
room.costsNote: We just do the maths — the money stays with you.

book.title: You found your people. Now let's put the trip together.
book.lead: There are two ways — the group decides. We're with you either way.
book.o1t: Pick a flight together; everyone books their own ticket with a ready-made link. Vote on where to stay; costs split automatically.
book.o2: We ask for a ready tour
book.o2t: We request prices for your group from verified agencies. They compete — you just compare and pick.

clubs.title: Clubs
clubs.lead: Not a one-off post — your own people. Join a club or start one: this is where trips are born.

stories.title: Memories
stories.lead: Back home: a shared album, stories and kind words for each other. If everyone agrees, we'll turn it into a page to show your friends.
stories.s1alt: A group of hikers in the mountains
stories.invite: Every trip is an invitation to the next one
stories.invitet: Shared pages have an "I want to go too" button.

facts.freet: Finding buddies and joining groups costs nothing
